_comment: How much CPU and memory crc-sync itself uses (docs/adr/0141): the METRICS panel's Server section and GET /api/server/resources. sampleMs: how often the process is sampled; windowMs: the rolling window every number covers (nothing is persisted). warn: past these the number turns amber (cpuPct is one core = 100; eventLoopP99Ms the 99th percentile event-loop delay; rssMb resident memory; tickMaxMs the slowest single run of any named ticker). Read once at startup.
